I strongly believe that all my achievements came from cooperation with people who share my goals. In 2016, I joined a volunteer program and met my first mentor, who supported me and my co-founder.

In 2020, the GYF selected me as one of 30 fellows in its Youth Fellowship for community leaders. Through that network we have trained more than 1,000 students.

In the UK, I will connect with student career groups and bring what I learn back to my community.
